purpose: Calibrate next-milestone ETA from real repository production and GateFlow conversion. Explicit token/work-package/risk telemetry outranks priors; priors shrink as measured data accumulates.

token_telemetry.note: Project-Frankenstein contains per-call/project trace infrastructure with tokens_in/tokens_out and session aggregation, but an explicit current 24h token total for this RAE program has not yet been located/materialized in the canonical repository. Do not invent one.

gateflow.anti_goodhart_rule: risk_retired_per_1m_tokens is mandatory beside gate-credit throughput. Negative evidence that blocks unsafe/invalid promotion is productive work and must not be optimized away.
gateflow.normalization_rule: Never fabricate token or worker-hour denominators. Emit null until the selected window has measured telemetry or an explicitly labelled proxy.

eta_model.uncertainty_rule: Show a range. Never present a point estimate as a deadline. Widen the range for first-of-kind stages, unresolved architecture blockers or missing telemetry.
eta_model.parallelism_rule: Observed multiworker throughput may reduce wall-clock ETA only when tasks are actually independent and completion receipts prove parallel progress. Never multiply throughput simply by worker count.
eta_model.rework_rule: Failed/falsified work increases observed cost and must remain in the calibration history rather than being hidden.
eta_model.goodhart_rule: Do not optimize accepted gate weight alone. Track risk retired in the same window so difficult falsification/safety work remains rewarded.
